prompt:
[Figure 1]

The scatterplot shows the number of birds $y$ in a flock observed by a researcher at various wind speeds $x$, in kilometers per hour. Between which of the following consecutive wind speeds did the greatest increase in the observed number of birds take place?
explanation: Choice C is correct. The scatterplot shows increases in the observed number of birds from $x = 42$ to $x = 48$, from $x = 54$ to $x = 60$, and from $x = 66$ to $x = 72$. When $x = 66$, the observed number of birds was approximately $27$, and when $x = 72$, the observed number of birds was approximately $38$. This means the increase from $x = 66$ to $x = 72$ was approximately $38 - 27 = 11$ birds. The increases from $x = 42$ to $x = 48$ (approximately $35 - 28 = 7$) and from $x = 54$ to $x = 60$ (approximately $31 - 24 = 7$) were each smaller. Therefore, the greatest increase took place from $x = 66$ to $x = 72$.
